summary: Retain browser runtime for asynchronous session-history traversal.

target.notes: Web IDL-convert delta to long; zero requests reload, an in-range nonzero delta schedules traversal, and an out-of-range delta does nothing.

caveats: Traversal integrates with document activation, persisted user state, popstate/pageshow and navigation algorithms.

tests.name: out-of-range is no-op
tests.expected_behavior: no traversal if no such entry exists

tests.name: zero means reload
tests.expected_behavior: requests reload of the current page
